versions.content: In case the Dem_J1939DcmSetRatioFilter, Dem_J1939DcmSetDTCFilter or Dem_J1939DcmSetFreezeFrameFilter returns E_NOT_OK , the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall call J1939Rm_SendAck with parameters ‘ackCode’ set to J1939RM_ACK_ NEGATIVE to send a negative acknowledgement (NACK) (considering [SWS_J1939Dcm_00113] ).
